english.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for someone performing for an audience, especially when the specific type of performer is not stated.

exampleSentences.english: The performer will go on stage at eight.
exampleSentences.traditional: 嗰位表演者八點鐘上台。
exampleSentences.jyutping: go2 wai2 biu2 jin2 ze2 baat3 dim2 zung1 soeng5 toi4

english.note: Use this for the performer in a particular show or act, especially when professional status is not the focus.

exampleSentences.english: The entertainer for this concert is a local singer.
exampleSentences.traditional: 今次演唱會嘅表演者係本地歌手。
exampleSentences.jyutping: gam1 ci3 jin2 coeng3 wui2 ge3 biu2 jin2 ze2 hai6 bun2 dei6 go1 sau2
